verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering professional legal services, not a software product with its own UI, so API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The Clerky formation workflow is a third-party partner platform, not a firm-built interface. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships an API or a UI of its own; the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
